points.description: Queue is implemented with a linked list where enqueue happens at the end (tail/rear) of the list and dequeue happens at the beginning (head/front) of the list.
points.partial_credit: Give about 2-3 marks if only one end is correctly stated (e.g. enqueue at tail OR dequeue at head), or if the answer just says to use a linked list with front and rear pointers without saying which operation is at which end.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that insertion (enqueue) is at the tail/rear and removal (dequeue) is at the head/front of the linked list, in any wording, however brief. Part marks if only one end is right or the answer is vague (e.g. just front and rear pointers on a list). No marks if the answer does not link the queue ends to the list ends, or reverses them (enqueue at head, dequeue at tail). Extra correct detail is fine.
